about: AA-847 Problem 2 - labelled destination pairs for the automatic duplicate merge (S246). label 'merge' = one real place, 'keep' = two places. src 's246' = the 22 pairs already pinned in CIS tests/unit/test_aa847_validity.py (review S246); 'task' = the cases named in the S246 brief; 'built' = constructed from real places of AA countries with approximate coordinates (author-labelled, NOT yet blind-labelled, NOT read from Dev). Place fields: by = located_by, prec = geo_precision, rt = Geoapify result_type, pid = geocoder_place_id, stop = overnight stop of a live tour (geo.tour_day.overnight_destination_id), card = place_card_id. src 'review' = the adversarial and linear pairs of the S246 skeptic review (Ben Thanh / Bitexco on a shared city id, loops vs towns, trail vs road, Nam Ou and Mekong stretches with shapes; a linear pair without a usable shape is deferred, which counts as not merged). Extra place fields: gname = the Geoapify result's own name (default: the row name), shape = {status, osm: [type, id] | null, line: [[lat, lng], ...]}. src 'skeptic' = the revised plan's adversarial keeps (same admin-area id for a ward and a landmark, temple vs stupa, a tributary touching its river); src 'homonym' = the homonym regression list of lesson 125 (similar names, different places). A 6th pair element {"label_needs": "metadata"} marks a label that only the stored metadata can justify (without the suburb result, 'Hoan Kiem' / 'Hoan Kiem Lake' is the s246 merge pair 'bare name of a lake'): such a pair is gated in the full-metadata run only. shape.class = place_shape.meta.line_class (water / road / trail from the OSM tags), what the same-line rule of the lines lane compares.
